title: Ultraviolet
description: Ultraviolet, the ultraviolet lighting look, is black-light cinema: a UV lamp as author, whites that scream, colors that only exist under that tube. The unseen made loud: a purple LUT on daylight is not a black light.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Clubs, forensics, a dream of a poster: teeth and cotton go radioactive, surroundings fall toward void. Glam is beauty key.
Neon practicals are colored tubes you can see as signage. UV is a lamp whose effect is the palette.
It is the wrong tool on a daylight exterior with a purple wash, and the wrong tool if cotton and teeth stay normal. If the whites are not blazing, the lamp is not UV.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Eye height, 35mm, lock-off. A black-light source in frame or implied as the only key.
Fluorescent whites, tonic violets, face with teeth and cotton blazing. Surroundings void.
No neon-sign letters. Prompt: Ultraviolet light on [Subject], black-light cinema, whites that scream, colors that only exist under that lamp.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Ultraviolet in film?
A lighting-device look: black-light cinema, whites that scream, colors that only exist under that lamp. Not a purple grade on daylight.
Ultraviolet vs Neon Practicals

Neon practicals are visible colored tubes in the set. Ultraviolet is a black light whose fluorescence is the palette. If you can read a neon word, you wanted neon. If teeth blaze in a void, you wanted UV.
When should I use Ultraviolet?
Clubs, forensics, poster dreams. Skip daylight exteriors with a purple wash.
How do I prompt Ultraviolet for AI image or video?

Name a black-light source, then: Ultraviolet light on [Subject], black-light cinema, whites that scream, colors that only exist under that lamp. Demand blazing cotton and teeth. Forbid a purple daylight LUT.
